name: 5G Networks
summary: Data-centre/cloud/network company (ASX: 5GN); founding entity 5G Networks Holdings Pty Ltd (ACN 163 312 025, ~2013), ASX-listed Nov 2017; delisted Nov 2021 via Webcentral Group scheme (2 Webcentral per 5GN share). The merged group survives as 5G Networks Limited (ACN 073 716 793) — legally the former Melbourne IT / Arq / Webcentral listed entity, renamed after absorbing 5GN.

events.details: Founding entity 5G Networks Holdings Pty Ltd (ACN 163 312 025; ACN block ≈ 2013). ABN/GST activated 1 Jan 2017 for the IPO; ASX-listed 17 Nov 2017. (Some external profiles cite 2016 as the operational founding.)

Delisted 26 Nov 2021 under a scheme of arrangement; Webcentral Group was the acquirer/surviving listed entity (2 new Webcentral shares per 5GN share); 5GN became a wholly-owned subsidiary. The surviving shell (legally former Melbourne IT / Arq / Webcentral, ACN 073 716 793) was subsequently renamed '5G Networks Limited'.
